vo01.text: Every day, money moves in a hundred small directions.

vo02.text: Meet Penni: a money coach that explains where it all goes.

vo03.text: Penni reads your own transactions, and sorts every euro into three baskets:

vo04.text: what you have to pay, what surprises you, and what you choose.

vo05.text: So you can see where an average month really goes.

vo06.text: Over a year, patterns start to show.

vo07.text: One washing machine in July meant ten days overdrawn.

vo08.text: Surprises are predictable. Extras are yours to steer.

vo09.text: And Penni keeps learning as you spend.

vo10.text: It turns patterns into lessons, and lessons into a plan: a hundred and twenty-five euros, every payday.

vo11.text: Your home screen changes with you.

vo12.text: Payday, a spike, a new habit: what matters now comes first.

vo13.text: And when you have a question, just ask.

vo14.text: Connect your other banks, and Penni sees the whole picture.

app.text: Your money goes into three baskets each month: about €2,510 on regular musts like housing (€1,133) and groceries, €500 on irregular musts like home and tech, and €455 on everyday extras like shopping and hobbies.
That everyday share, 13%, is lower than the 18% people aged 35–44 in Finland typically spend (Statistics Finland, 2022).

vo05b.text: Then it compares you with people your age, using Statistics Finland data.
